text: No 'radar' anywhere; list rule keys/ids and descriptions in the regime JSON near the window specs to find a clock/time-of-day rule.
command: cd /work/domains/airline/crew/legality/src/regimes && timeout 20 grep -n -i -e '"ruleId"' -e '"rule"' -e '"name"' -e '"label"' -e 'clock' racp.json cars705.json | head -60
